# langsmith_chart_section (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith custom chart section (dashboard section).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_chart_section" "example" {
  title       = "Performance Metrics"
  description = "Charts tracking latency and throughput"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) The title of the chart section.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the chart section.
- `index` (Number) The display order index.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the chart section.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
